4399-4770-5070-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.

2178-5931-5970-6798.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-5931-5970-6798.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-5931-5970-6798.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

Repeat from step 2.

Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Living Laser as attackers.
Living Laser triggers, creating at least one creature token.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7760.notes: If you've discarded more than one card, you'll make more tokens each loop.

1636-4027-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature with greater mana value than Glint Hawk that can be cast using only mana creatures you control can produce.
1636-4027-5914.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Glint Hawk.
Cast Glint Hawk by paying its mana cost.
When Glint Hawk enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Glint Hawk trigger, returning the other creature with greater mana value from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast the creature returned to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Glint Hawk from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4027-5914.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

3388-4004-7149.description:

Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Moritte of the Frost enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Moritte of the Frost leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Moritte of the Frost from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-2921-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

Repeat each combat phase.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.

If the sacrificed creature had mana value 4 or greater, this combo nets infinite black and red mana.
